statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of home, category, video detail, search-empty, and 404 templates.

page.notes: Arabic adult-media catalog. Public SSR templates with JavaScript enhancement, analytics, and advertising.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Dark emulation did not change the light palette.
No active Web Animations were present under reduced-motion, and no autoplaying media appeared on the home path.

checkOutcomes.method: Emulated prefers-contrast probe and screenshot review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Text and controls remained rendered under prefers-contrast: more; separate baseline contrast defects are recorded under be-inclusive.
No View Transition declarations were found across MPA templates.
No parallax, scrollytelling, or scroll-linked animation exists on the representative templates, so there is no scroll animation implementation to evaluate.
checkOutcomes.reason: No parallax, scrollytelling, or scroll-linked animation exists on the representative templates, so there is no scroll animation implementation to evaluate.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No swipe, pull-to-reveal, carousel gesture, or custom pointer-driven interaction exists on the sampled templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No swipe, pull-to-reveal, carousel gesture, or custom pointer-driven interaction exists on the sampled templates.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The page has no sticky/affixed chrome that needs scroll-state adaptation; navigation remains outside the content flow and does not obscure scrolling.
No tooltip, popover, or edge-positioned overlay was present on the sampled paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No tooltip, popover, or edge-positioned overlay was present on the sampled paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Selected navigation state, page H1, result query, and 404 heading identify the destination after navigation.

checkOutcomes.method: Initial-load screenshot and DOM overlay probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: No modal, interstitial, or full-viewport overlay obscured content on initial load on the four templates.
No dismissible overlay or disclosure control was encountered; DOM probe found zero dialog/popover elements.
checkOutcomes.reason: No dismissible overlay or disclosure control was encountered; DOM probe found zero dialog/popover elements.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Third-party tiles and unrelated search copy precede primary content.
At 360x800, scrollWidth and clientWidth are both 360, horizontal overflow is 0, and mobile templates reflow to one column.
Probe found zero container rules for reusable card components.
Sampled controls have no visible focus outline and 7 controls are undersized.
Home, category, video, and search templates expose descriptive H1/title text and obvious linked cards/search controls.

checkOutcomes.method: Search journey screenshot and DOM review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The search flow completes but unrelated injected copy obscures the empty-result outcome.
Empty search explicitly reports no data, and a real HTTP 404 presents a visible Page not found state plus onward content links.
Lighthouse mobile LCP is 3.9s while CLS is 0 and TBT 10ms.
Mobile layout observer measured CLS 0 with no shifts; Lighthouse also measured CLS 0.
Trace found one 81.95ms long task and 31.95ms TBT; Lighthouse TBT was 9ms, both within a light overall main-thread profile.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary and Lighthouse delivery insights
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse reports 128 KiB cache savings and delayed LCP discovery.
Lighthouse estimates 147 KiB unused JavaScript and 17 KiB unused CSS.

checkOutcomes.method: axe, Lighthouse, and DOM control probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Menu button lacks a name and search input lacks a label.
axe reports 116 failures and measured representative metadata at 1.89:1.

checkOutcomes.method: axe structural audit and focus walk
checkOutcomes.evidence: No main landmark, nonsequential headings, two H1s, and no visible sampled focus styles.
Primary Arabic titles and card text remain readable without clipping at 360px; line lengths are short and card wrapping remains intact.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse/axe viewport and target audits plus video DOM inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Viewport disables scaling; touch targets fail; representative video has no track.
Lighthouse errors-in-console audit passed with zero captured items.
Doctype/UTF-8 pass, but 13 images lack dimensions and Lighthouse flags low-resolution assets.
Lighthouse records BFCache exclusion and browser inspector cookie issues.
All representative templates have descriptive titles; public content templates have specific descriptions, while utility states retain a generic description.
Lighthouse finds sort/support anchors without href; viewport zoom is disabled.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, robots/sitemap fetch, and HTTP status probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home exposes canonical; robots allows public content and advertises a current sitemap; sampled public URLs return 200 and the missing URL returns 404.
Home has JSON-LD plus complete Open Graph title, URL, image, description and type; video DOM contains two JSON-LD blocks.
HTTPS passes, but CSP/HSTS/nosniff are missing and session cookies are insecure.
16 third-party requests transfer 298,060 bytes before any visible consent.

checkOutcomes.method: Initial-load screenshot, DOM, and Lighthouse prompt review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No notification/geolocation prompt fired on load and no authentication was part of the public core flow; modern auth is not applicable to the sampled anonymous journey.
Only X-Frame-Options is present; CSP, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and nosniff are absent.
Raw server HTML retains 87% of rendered content words, title, H1 and description; it is not a JS shell.
MPA templates render stable content with no clipped overlay; menu repetition did not destabilize DOM/heap.
This public streaming/content MPA is intrinsically network-dependent; no installable/offline product intent was declared, so PWA installability is not required.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public streaming/content MPA is intrinsically network-dependent; no installable/offline product intent was declared, so PWA installability is not required.

checkOutcomes.evidence: A true 404 response shows a clear error and onward content; empty search shows an explicit no-data state rather than a broken shell.
Arabic templates declare lang=en, omit dir, and compute to ltr.
Arabic UI includes untranslated English relative dates, labels and error text.
The sampled public templates expose no scheduled event, absolute time, calendar, or cross-zone workflow to evaluate.
checkOutcomes.reason: The sampled public templates expose no scheduled event, absolute time, calendar, or cross-zone workflow to evaluate.

checkOutcomes.method: Video screenshot, cookie and tracker review
checkOutcomes.evidence: Unlabelled third-party tiles mimic content and tracking begins with no visible choice.
The sampled search form has no required or constrained user input and therefore no validation-error interaction to judge.
checkOutcomes.reason: The sampled search form has no required or constrained user input and therefore no validation-error interaction to judge.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No address, payment, sign-in, or sign-up inputs appear in the sampled anonymous flows; search intentionally uses a query field only.
checkOutcomes.reason: No address, payment, sign-in, or sign-up inputs appear in the sampled anonymous flows; search intentionally uses a query field only.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No checkout, subscription, authentication, consent purchase, or account-management flow was exercised in the public content scope.
checkOutcomes.reason: No checkout, subscription, authentication, consent purchase, or account-management flow was exercised in the public content scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: 49 images lack srcset; many are legacy format or miss dimensions/native lazy loading.
Initial analytics/ad scripts perform substantial unused work before interaction.
Third parties consume 44% of initial transferred bytes.
This is a passive public media catalog with crawlable SSR and no agent-executable transactional capability; emerging WebMCP tools are not applicable to the sampled scope.
checkOutcomes.reason: This is a passive public media catalog with crawlable SSR and no agent-executable transactional capability; emerging WebMCP tools are not applicable to the sampled scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarization, generation, or language task is part of the site’s user flow, so on-device inference would add complexity without demonstrated value.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarization, generation, or language task is part of the site’s user flow, so on-device inference would add complexity without demonstrated value.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After 20 menu toggles, summary size rose only 9,857 bytes (0.10%) and node count by 174 (0.11%), with closures +8; no unbounded growth signal appeared in this bounded test.
Baseline summary is 9.40 MB self size and 162,878 nodes, proportionate to the content-heavy page in this single-state sample.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap type and constructor comparison
checkOutcomes.evidence: Native node count fell by 7 and closures rose by only 8 after 20 menu toggles; top constructor populations remained effectively flat.

principleOutcomes.reason: This is a passive public media catalog with crawlable SSR and no agent-executable transactional capability; emerging WebMCP tools are not applicable to the sampled scope. No summarization, generation, or language task is part of the site’s user flow, so on-device inference would add complexity without demonstrated value.

paths.description: Homepage and primary listing template; tests entry experience, navigation, cards, global metadata, performance, security, preferences, and mobile reflow.
Representative category/listing archetype; covers repeated card template, Arabic metadata, navigation and mobile layout.
Representative detail/playback archetype; covers primary media, advertising placement, captions, forms and structured metadata without starting explicit playback.
Primary search journey with a low-match query; covers result clarity, empty state, localization and recovery.
Representative HTTP failure state; covers truthful status, recovery links and localization.

findings.summary: The site ignores the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The normal and prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots are pixel-identical in the main surfaces; the dark probe reports color-scheme: normal and the page retains its white background.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven dark surface, text, border, and media treatments using prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Cross-document navigation swaps abruptly.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition-name or @view-transition rules; the MPA’s category, search, and detail navigations therefore use full abrupt swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for shared header/content elements, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Advertising and unrelated material crowd the primary video and search content.
findings.evidence: The video mobile screenshot places four third-party ad tiles before the requested title/player, and the search screenshot inserts an unrelated English paragraph before the results heading.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label and reduce advertising, reserve the first content region for the requested task, and remove unrelated injected copy from search results.

findings.summary: Reusable cards adapt only through page-level responsive CSS, not their container.
findings.evidence: The rendered DOM/CSS probe found zero container rules although the same video cards appear in desktop grids and single-column mobile layouts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable card/list wrappers containment and use @container rules for card metadata and media sizing, retaining viewport fallbacks where needed.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is globally suppressed and several targets are too small.
findings.evidence: The active focus probe reports outline style none and no box shadow for sampled links, search input, and menu button; Lighthouse target-size fails and the probe counts 7 targets below 24px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the global outline reset, add high-contrast :focus-visible styles, and enlarge/space touch targets to at least the applicable WCAG target size.

findings.summary: Search results are polluted by unrelated content before the result state.
findings.evidence: Searching for “test” completes with no matching videos, but the mobile result page first renders an unrelated English paragraph and ad-like text before “مقاطع لـ: test”, obscuring the task result.
findings.suggestedFix: Render the query, result count, and empty state immediately; remove third-party or injected text from the search result flow.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP misses the good threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 3.9s (score 0.52) and identified the first thumbnail as undiscoverable for LCP with no fetchpriority=high; the direct trace measured 1.11s in a separate desktop run.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the LCP image directly discoverable in initial HTML, provide the right responsive source, and set fetchpriority=high only on the actual LCP candidate.

findings.summary: Cache policy and LCP delivery leave avoidable delay.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 128 KiB repeat-load cache savings; font-display can save 30ms, and the LCP image lacks priority/discovery. HAR records 46 requests and 670,502 transferred bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use long immutable caching for versioned static assets, font-display, responsive LCP markup, and verify the two parser-blocking stylesheets are both critical.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 147 KiB unused JS (including analytics, first-party main.js, and ad-provider.js) plus 17 KiB unused CSS; 82.6% of the main stylesheet was unused in this route.
findings.suggestedFix: Split route code/styles, conditionally load media and ad dependencies, and remove unused first- and third-party code after coverage testing.

findings.summary: Core controls lack accessible names and labels.
findings.evidence: axe and Lighthouse report a critical button-name failure for the mobile navigation button; the search input has no label or aria-label.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an accessible name and expanded state to the menu button, and associate a visible or programmatic label with the search input.

findings.summary: Metadata text has severely insufficient contrast.
findings.evidence: axe reports 116 color-contrast failures; Lighthouse measured 1.89:1 for 12px duration, date, and view-count text against white, below the required 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken secondary text and verify all text/control states with automated contrast tests and forced-colors checks.

findings.summary: Landmark, heading, and focus structure is not usable enough.
findings.evidence: axe reports no main landmark, content outside landmarks, and a heading-order failure. The page has two H1 elements and jumps to H4; focused elements have no visible outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page-level H1, sequential headings, a main landmark, and persistent visible :focus-visible indicators in DOM reading order.

findings.summary: The viewport disables zoom and the representative video has no text track.
findings.evidence: The viewport sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=0, which axe/Lighthouse classify as critical. Video DOM inspection found a video element but no track, while Lighthouse also reports undersized targets.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow pinch zoom, increase target sizes, and provide synchronized captions or an equivalent transcript for video content.

findings.summary: Image and document semantics have avoidable defects.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports 13 images without dimensions; Lighthouse reports unsized and low-resolution images. The page also has duplicate H1s although doctype and UTF-8 are valid.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio to every image, serve sufficient responsive resolution, and correct heading structure.

findings.summary: The page is excluded from BFCache and triggers browser inspector issues.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons caused by Cache-Control: no-store and cookie mutation, plus cookie issues in third-party ad requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid no-store on public pages and nonessential async resources, minimize cookie mutation, and re-test BFCache and the Issues panel.

findings.summary: Several user-visible links are not crawlable.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse finds sort and support anchors without href values, relying on data-action/data-href JavaScript. The viewport also disables user scaling.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations for sort/support actions with JavaScript as enhancement, and remove zoom restrictions.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie flags are materially weak.
findings.evidence: HTTPS is used, but headers evidence shows no CSP, HSTS, or nosniff. Cookies evidence finds 8/8 cookies insecure; PHPSESSID is neither Secure nor HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy CSP in report-only then enforcement, HSTS, nosniff, and secure session cookies with Secure, HttpOnly, and an appropriate SameSite value.

findings.summary: Tracking and advertising run before visible consent with a large third-party footprint.
findings.evidence: HAR records 16 third-party requests and 298,060 third-party bytes (44% of transfer), including Google Analytics and multiple ad domains; the tracker scan finds 7 third-party origins and no consent UI appears in load screenshots.
findings.suggestedFix: Block nonessential analytics/ads until informed consent where required, minimize fields and retention, and remove unneeded third parties.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policy coverage is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The response has X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN but lacks CSP/frame-ancestors, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and X-Content-Type-Options.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a least-privilege CSP including frame-ancestors, strict referrer and permissions policies, HSTS, and nosniff; test in report-only where appropriate.

findings.summary: Arabic pages are declared as English and left-to-right.
findings.evidence: All sampled home, category, video, search, and 404 documents use html lang="en" with no dir; the computed root direction is ltr despite predominantly Arabic content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="ar" and dir="rtl" on Arabic templates, mark embedded English spans with lang/dir as needed, and migrate layout to logical properties.

findings.summary: Arabic UI mixes untranslated, non-locale-aware metadata.
findings.evidence: Mobile pages render English strings such as “2 days ago”, “Albums for: test”, “Most Relevant”, and “Page not found” inside otherwise Arabic interfaces.
findings.suggestedFix: Centralize strings and format relative times, dates, numbers, and durations with Intl using the active Arabic locale.

findings.summary: Unlabelled ad content and tracking undermine informed, predictable use.
findings.evidence: The requested video is preceded by four third-party tiles styled like content without an advertisement label, while tracking/ad requests and long-lived cookies start with no visible consent choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label ads, separate them from site content, avoid deceptive placement, and provide an honest consent flow before nonessential tracking.

findings.summary: Image delivery is not responsive or consistently modern.
findings.evidence: The images primitive reports 49/49 images without srcset, 15 legacy-format images, 45 below-fold images without native loading=lazy, and 13 missing dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive srcsets and sizes, reserve dimensions, and use native lazy loading below the fold while keeping the true LCP image eager.

findings.summary: Background analytics and advertising perform disproportionate work.
findings.evidence: Third parties transfer 298,060 bytes across 16 requests on initial load; Lighthouse attributes 70 KiB unused code to gtag and 37 KiB to the ad provider.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove nonessential vendors, load consented analytics during idle time, batch events, and do not initialize ad/media work outside the viewport.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts dominate the initial resource budget.
findings.evidence: HAR shows third parties account for 44% of transferred bytes; gtag alone is 166,615 bytes and ad/behavior scripts add tens of kilobytes before user interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party byte/request budget, defer approved vendors, and remove scripts whose measured user value does not justify their cost.

taskList.title: Restore zoom, keyboard focus, accessible names, landmarks, captions, contrast, and target sizing
Harden response headers and session cookies, then reduce pre-consent tracking
Correct Arabic lang/dir and localize UI/data strings
Clean the search/detail journey and clearly label or remove ad content
Optimize LCP discovery, caching, code splitting, and responsive images
Add preference-driven dark mode and progressive cross-document transitions
Use crawlable hrefs and container-aware card styling
